changelog:
Initial release of Focus Flow Optimizer Free: an AI Agent-driven productivity OS for personal focus management.

- Integrates energy management, time blocking, and task prioritization into a single local system.
- Provides structured workflows for bottleneck diagnosis, task sorting, and review routines.
- Features explicit user authorization for file writing to maintain trust and data integrity.
- Includes templates and quick-start guides for rapid setup (minimal and standard configurations).
- Offers practical frameworks for daily/weekly planning, energy-based scheduling, and anti-overload workflows.
summary: AI Agent驱动的个人专注流操作系统，整合能量管理、时间块与任务优先级，解决碎片化与拖延痛点。
